data.change_summary: Added a new prescriptive design note at `docs/ROUTING.md` that defines the phase-1 closed-loop routing policy for consumer ingestion, feces, excretion, respiration, death/senescence, detritus decay, and maintenance/export actions. Updated `docs/UNITS.md`, `docs/scientific_inventory.md`, and `docs/scientific_specs.md` to point at the new routing contract and added a compact routing cross-reference section in the scientific inventory so downstream implementation beads can cite one agreed policy.
outstanding_risks: The routing note defines future parameter names and split rules, but the corresponding `ProcessParams` fields and runtime logic are still for downstream implementation beads rather than this docs-only change.
Microfauna routing remains intentionally approximate because the runtime model still stores microfauna as a `population_index` instead of explicit biomass.

Respiration and excretion are intentionally lumped into DIC and TAN respectively; carbonate speciation, urea/DON excretion detail, and shell/mineral routing remain deferred to later scientific-core work.

steps.description: Drafted `docs/ROUTING.md` with the closed-loop routing policy, pool topology, consumer split rules, death-to-detritus rules, maintenance/export semantics, and intentional lumping notes.

Updated `docs/UNITS.md`, `docs/scientific_inventory.md`, and `docs/scientific_specs.md` to cross-reference the new routing policy and added a routing cross-reference subsection to the scientific inventory.
Validated the markdown edits for consistency and coverage against the bead prompt.

validation_evidence: `git diff --check` completed with no whitespace or patch-format errors.

Manual review of `docs/ROUTING.md` confirmed explicit coverage for ingestion -> assimilation/feces, assimilation -> respiration/excretion, feed -> particulate/fine detritus/dissolved decay, trim export vs leave-cuttings, death -> fine detritus, and maintenance export actions.
`git status --short docs` shows the intended docs-only change set: modified `docs/UNITS.md`, `docs/scientific_inventory.md`, `docs/scientific_specs.md`, and new `docs/ROUTING.md`.
